title: agent-bridge peer consultation response, contract version 2
description: Version 2 exists because the two peers enforce schemas differently. Codex routes --output-schema through OpenAI structured outputs, which requires every key in properties to also appear in required, at every object level. Version 1 left analysis, disagreements, risks, questions and mitigation optional, so Codex rejected it outright with invalid_json_schema while Claude accepted it. Every field is therefore required here, and absence is expressed as an empty array or an empty string rather than a missing key.

analysis.description: Substantive points supporting your answer. Empty if the summary says it all.

disagreements.description: Specific disagreements with a position the caller actually stated in the question. Empty when the caller stated no position, or when you have no disagreement. Never populate this against a position nobody took: a fabricated objection is worse than none, because the caller may act on it.

risks.description: Risks you actually identify. Empty if you see none worth naming.

questions.description: Facts you need from the caller to answer. Empty unless status is needs_context.
